subject: german

questions.explain: 'Im Ausland' means 'abroad'. 'Das Ausland' = foreign countries; 'das Inland' = home country.

questions.q: How do you say 'My phone battery is empty'?
questions.explain: 'Der Akku' = 'the battery' and 'leer' = 'empty'; 'voll' (full) is the trap.
'Der Treibhauseffekt' means 'the greenhouse effect'.

questions.q: How do you say 'The hotel was right by the beach'?
options: Das Hotel war weit vom Strand
Das Hotel ist direkt am Strand
Das Hotel war direkt am Strand
Das Hotel war direkt an der Straße
questions.explain: 'War' = 'was', 'direkt am Strand' = 'right by the beach'; 'Straße' (street) is the trap.
'Die Überschwemmung' means 'the flood/flooding'.

options: To store food in a larder
questions.explain: 'Speichern' means 'to save' a file or data on a computer.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We should save energy'?
questions.explain: 'Sparen' = 'to save' and 'verschwenden' = 'to waste'; 'Wir sollten Energie sparen' = 'We should save energy'.

questions.q: What does 'Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt' mean?
options: At the moment I live in the city
I will live in the city
I rarely live in the city
I used to live in the city
questions.explain: 'Zurzeit' means 'at the moment / currently', so this is 'At the moment I live in the city'.
'Die Innenstadt' means 'the town/city centre'; 'der Stadtrand' is the outskirts.
'Berühmt' means 'famous', e.g. 'Er ist berühmt für seine Musik' = 'He is famous for his music'.

questions.q: What does 'das Viertel' mean (in a town)?
questions.explain: 'Das Viertel' means 'the neighbourhood/district' of a town (also 'a quarter' in time).
'Die Dürre' means 'the drought' (a long dry spell).
'In der Nähe' means 'nearby/close by', e.g. 'in der Nähe der Schule' = 'near the school'.
'Die Wohnung' means 'the flat/apartment'.

questions.q: How do you say 'My house has a large garden'?
options: Mein Haus hat einen großen Garten
Meine Wohnung hat einen großen Garten
Mein Haus hat einen kleinen Garten
questions.explain: 'Einen großen Garten' = 'a large garden'; 'kleinen' (small) is the distractor.
'Die Armut' means 'poverty'; from 'arm' = poor.
'Verreisen' means 'to go away/travel (somewhere)'.
'Der Müll' means 'rubbish/waste'. 'Müll trennen' = 'to separate the rubbish (for recycling)'.
'Das Ausland' means 'abroad/foreign countries'; 'im Ausland' = abroad.
'Die Sendung' means 'the (TV/radio) programme/show' (it can also mean a parcel in other contexts).

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I separate the rubbish for recycling'?
options: Ich trenne den Müll zum Recycling
questions.explain: 'Trennen' = 'to separate/sort' and 'zum Recycling' = 'for recycling'.
'Die sozialen Medien' means 'social media' (also 'soziale Netzwerke' = social networks).
